reviewer: root original-endpoint review with independent PI audit
reason: Stable allocation among nine response pairs could reflect formula-specific collocation or unequal exposure without functional gating. The design specifies no allowed set, distribution, effect criterion, exposure model or held partition. GDT873 collapses pair identity into CH/SH density, so it cannot test this allocation claim.

design.contrast: pair-specific downstream inventory versus a common procedure pool whose pair identities are exchangeable
design.countermodel: Page formula reuse or unequal anchor placement can produce a stable response-pair distribution without a lexical or functional inventory rule.
design.falsifier: Balanced held strata show response-pair allocations interchangeable between SP10 and SP11, while only side totals vary; the pair-gating account then loses its prediction.
design.prediction: Within fixed direction, lag-band, paragraph and folio strata, each anchor pair should show a reproducible response-pair distribution; a common-pool model predicts no stable anchor-pair-specific pair allocation beyond exposure.
design.principal_risk: The observed report gives aggregate counts, not independent response-pair bindings or a semantic inventory. Availability of balanced held occurrences is unknown.
design.related: Near GDT872’s retained nine-pair table, but asks about pair identity conditionality rather than the already reported CH/SH aggregate composition or a position-only control.
design.smallest_next_step: Freeze anchor-side, direction, lag-band, paragraph and folio strata; then inspect held response-side records without changing the GDT872 pair inventory.

source_evidence.quote:
The response-side composition is worth preserving separately: in distal within-
paragraph ZL hits,41/51 forward responses are CH-side versus36/66 backward.
Forward CH-side responses occur after both CH anchors (25/31) and SH anchors
(16/20). Thus pooled same-side concordance is misleading as a state-copying
interpretation. The strict diagnostic has7/9 CH-side forward and5/6 backward;
it does not reproduce the primary directional composition contrast. Its small,
selectively retained sample does not prove the primary contrast false either.
All nine response pairs contribute distal hits; the counts are retained rather
than selecting a winning pair after inspection.

design.unit: the two anchor pairs SP10/SP11 crossed with the nine fixed response pairs at signed lags 3–8, retaining response pair and side separately

blockers.detail: Stable allocation among nine response pairs could reflect formula-specific collocation or unequal exposure without functional gating. The design specifies no allowed set, distribution, effect criterion, exposure model or held partition. GDT873 collapses pair identity into CH/SH density, so it cannot test this allocation claim.

not_sufficient: Treating GDT873 as a failed test of this different endpoint.
Relabelling already inspected GDT872 records as untouched held confirmation.
More pages or another CH majority without the declared contrasting prediction.

relations.detail: Motivating observation; neither independent semantic binding nor held confirmation.

claim_ceiling: Original semantic proposition remains untested, not falsified; unknown capacity is not measured capacity failure; effective source/design preserved.
